judge.evidence_requirement: For every routing assertion, quote or reference exact Skill lifecycle evidence; the description and output prose do not prove activation.

dimensions.description: Selects Readme Writing for creating, rewriting, restructuring, or reviewing a project's README.
Leaves agent-facing guidance files, reference documentation, changelogs, release notes, and ordinary human replies to their owning outcomes.

evals.name: create a project README
evals.prompt: Write a README for this repository so a stranger can tell what it is for and get started.
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing activates for creating a project README.
expectations: The host records Readme Writing activation by its canonical name.

evals.name: restructure an existing README
evals.prompt: Our README reads like a generic markdown document. Restructure it the way popular open source projects do, keeping the project's own purpose.
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing activates for rewriting or restructuring an existing README.
expectations: The host records Readme Writing activation for the README restructuring request.

evals.name: review a README
evals.prompt: Review this project's README and tell me which claims are wrong or missing for a first-time reader. Do not change the file.
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing activates for a read-only README review.
expectations: The host records Readme Writing activation for the README review request.

evals.name: canonical direct invocation
evals.prompt:
/readme-writing

Rewrite the README for this package.
evals.expected_output: Direct canonical invocation selects Readme Writing.
expectations: The host records invocation of Readme Writing by its exact canonical name.

evals.name: agent guidance file exclusion
evals.prompt: Create an AGENTS.md that tells future coding agents how to change this repository and which commands to run.
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing stays inactive because Agents File Writer owns agent-facing guidance files.
expectations: The host does not record Readme Writing activation for an AGENTS.md request.

evals.name: reference documentation and changelog exclusion
evals.prompt: Write the API reference page for the configuration options and add a changelog entry for the 2.3.0 release.
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing stays inactive because reference pages, changelogs, and release notes are not the project front page.
expectations: The host does not record Readme Writing activation for reference documentation or changelog work.

evals.name: plain human reply exclusion
evals.prompt: Explain to my teammate in a short message why the deploy was delayed this morning.
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing stays inactive because To Humans owns ordinary human-facing replies.
expectations: The host does not record Readme Writing activation for an ordinary human reply.

evals.name: ambient README mention is not activation
evals.prompt: What does a README usually contain, in general terms?
evals.expected_output: Readme Writing stays inactive because the user asked for a general explanation rather than README work on a project.
expectations: The host does not record Readme Writing activation for a general explanatory question.
